verdict.rationale: Ashby docs confirm a public Job Posting API and a documented 3-step process for building a careers page (ashby-docs-4, ashby-docs-5), but this describes an engineering-driven, API-based integration rather than a turnkey, brandable hosted page on a custom domain with zero engineering effort. No evidence shows a no-code, drag-and-drop branded careers-page builder or domain-mapping flow. Missing for 10: evidence of no-code page branding/theming UI, custom-domain hosting setup, and confirmation that job publishing to that page requires zero developer involvement.
